note: This file is a pure configuration dictionary for MMSegmentation. It defines model settings for BiSeNetV2 semantic segmentation with no callable functions, classes, or APIs. It is composed entirely of variable assignments (norm_cfg, data_preprocessor, model) used as config references by the MMSegmentation framework.
summarize_bisenetv2_config: summarize the BiSeNetV2 model config for semantic segmentation with 19 classes
review_bisenetv2_backbone: review the BiSeNetV2 backbone config with detail and semantic channels
review_fcn_decode_head: review the FCNHead decode head config with cross entropy loss
review_auxiliary_heads: review the four auxiliary FCNHead configs for multi-scale training
review_data_preprocessor: review the SegDataPreProcessor config with BGR to RGB conversion
